_comment: EXAMPLE. This is not the real config. Copy it to your user config with 'python -m claude_informes init' and replace these fictitious paths with your own. This file, versioned in the repo, MUST NOT contain any real path of anyone.
_raiz_informes: Global root of the archive. It MUST live OUTSIDE any git repository: the reports carry the full text of sessions and must not end up versioned or on a remote. Each project can declare its own and override this one.

proyectos._note: a sensitive project can be archived under a separate root
